Check the eligibility response for this patient's upcoming lab follow-up. If it isn't in force, send the clinician the visit is booked with a message about the appointment, and name that clinician.
Context: patient MRN SYN-402c9c6841 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2025-09-13, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date; its clinician is the Practitioner of the PractitionerRole among its participants. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "clinician": ..., "alerted": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and clinician (string: that Practitioner's name text, or its given names and family name joined by spaces). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinician with that Practitioner and $appointment with the lab visit: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinician"}], "about": [{"reference": "$appointment"}]}. alerted (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the PractitionerRole and the Practitioner), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
tasks.prompt:
For patient MRN SYN-402c9c6841, check the lab follow-up after 2025-09-13; if coverage isn't in force, send a message to the booked clinician about that appointment.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {alerted: true/false, clinician: text, in_force: true/false, visit_date: date YYYY-MM-DD}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.

tasks.original_prompt:
Check this patient's latest hemoglobin. If it's low, create a follow-up task on the report it came back on; otherwise change nothing.
Context: patient MRN SYN-402c9c6841 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2025-10-11, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ..., "task_created": ...}. latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low; both are null when no result was ever low. Only when still_low is true, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $report with the DiagnosticReport whose basedOn references the ServiceRequest the latest result's basedOn references and whose result lists the latest result: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$report"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, and its DiagnosticReport when you create the Task; when no result was ever low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
tasks.prompt:
For MRN SYN-402c9c6841, as of 2025-10-11, if the latest hemoglobin is low, add a follow-up task to that lab report; otherwise do nothing.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {latest: {date: date YYYY-MM-DD, unit: text, value: number}, still_low: true/false, task_created: true/false}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
required_changes: only if the patient's most recent hemoglobin is low, create a new Task (status requested, intent order) for the patient whose focus is the lab report (DiagnosticReport) listing that most recent result; otherwise change nothing
rewrite_changes: only if the patient's most recent hemoglobin is low, create a new Task (status requested, intent order) for the patient whose focus is the lab report (DiagnosticReport) listing that most recent result; otherwise change nothing
